top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a genuine chemical invention, reversible-terminator fluorescent nucleotides read out on clonally amplified surface clusters, that has been independently confirmed for two decades and made massively parallel sequencing possible. The Balasubramanian and Klenerman allocation is the least contested attribution on the list, it respects the three-laureate limit, and a citation naming the chemistry keeps the scope clear of the unrewarded 454 and semiconductor lineage. P002 is a mature, clearly attributable method but a narrower extension of the 2010 cross-coupling prize, so it ranks second, ahead of no award.
